task: Find a walkthrough for the game "The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild" on ign.
final_result_response:
Found the walkthrough for The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild on IGN:

URL: https://www.ign.com/wikis/the-legend-of-zelda-breath-of-the-wild/Walkthrough
Title: Walkthrough - The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild Guide - IGN

It includes detailed strategies for the main story from Link's awakening to the final boss, with recommended order: The Shrine of Resurrection, Follow the Sheikah Slate, The Isolated Plateau, Seek Out Impa, Locked Mementos, Find the Fairy Fountain, Captured Memories, Free the Divine Beasts (Reach Zora's Domain / Vah Ruta, Vah Rudania, Vah Medoh, Forbidden City Entry / Vah Naboris), The Hero's Sword, Destroy Ganon, plus The Master Trials DLC (Trial of the Sword) and The Champions' Ballad DLC walkthroughs, and 76 Side Quests.
